* A note about GPUs

I want a 1080

You cannot realistically get a 1080 in a laptop. It comes down to simple physics - faster GPUs draw more power, which requires more cooling, which a laptop is severely limited in. The thinner and sleeker it is - the worse it's at cooling.

But this thin laptop is listed having a 1080 inside it

It's all marketing bullshit. It's the same GPU with inadequate cooling. Expect the laptop to overheat, max out the fans, then throttle down a little, essentially having lower performance than a desktop 1070 (for the price of a 1080).

Admiteddly, this problem was small with the 10-series cards, but it's awful with the 20-series cards. Right now, for anything above an RTX 2060, you're getting drastically diminishing returns on your investment. To make it worse, Nvidia sells multiple versions of their 20-series GPUs with the same name - and RTX 2060 can have a TDP of 65W, 90W, or 105W, which makes a huge difference in performance. It's a giant clusterfuck.
